Privacy notice

How we handle the details you send through the early access form.

Last updated: October 2026

Who is responsible

The data controller is José Manuel Pérez (IGO Tech project). Contact: igotech@gmail.com.

What we collect

The details you enter in the early access form: your name, email address and product interest, and optionally your company, role and a message.

Why we use it

To reply to your request and to contact you about early access to IGO. We do not use your details for anything else.

Legal basis

Your consent, which you give by ticking the box in the form. You can withdraw it at any time.

Who receives it

A form-processing service provider receives each request on our behalf and forwards it to us by email. We do not sell your details.

How long we keep it

Only as long as needed to handle your request and early access communications, or until you ask us to delete it.

Your rights

You can ask us to access, correct or delete your details, to restrict or object to their use, or to withdraw your consent, by contacting the controller above. You can also complain to your data protection authority.
